intro: The following analysis summarizes the SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam conducted on 11 October 2026. Data from shift 1 and shift 2 are based on candidate reports and are unofficial; the SSC normalises scores across shifts. Shift 1 is described as ranging from easy to moderate with about 17‑18 good attempts, while shift 2 appears easier with average attempts of 20‑23 per section. Shift 3 has not yet been analysed, so no usable analysis is available at this time.

faqs.q: What was the overall difficulty reported for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam on 11 October 2026?
faqs.a: Shift 1 was reported as ranging from Easy to Moderate, while Shift 2 was described as Easy across all sections. No difficulty assessment is available for Shift 3 because its analysis is still pending.

faqs.q: How many questions were typically attempted correctly on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam on 11 October 2026?
faqs.a: For Shift 1, candidates reported good attempts on roughly 17‑18 questions overall. In Shift 2, average attempts were about 20‑23 per section, with correct answers ranging from 14.7 to 21.3. No data is yet available for Shift 3.

faqs.q: Are the marks and attempts figures for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam on 11 October 2026 official?
faqs.a: No. The figures presented are unofficial candidate reports, and the SSC normalises scores across shifts before publishing official results.

faqs.q: What is the current status of the analysis for Shift 3 of the SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam on 11 October 2026?
faqs.a: Shift 3 is still pending analysis. No usable analysis has been published yet, and more candidate evidence is required before a summary can be provided.

faqs.q: When will a complete analysis for all shifts of the SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam on 11 October 2026 be available?
faqs.a: A complete analysis will be posted once sufficient data from all shifts has been collected and reviewed; a specific publication time cannot be guaranteed.
